Route runoff through quick and slow linear stores with optional losses

Source: R/routing_ihacres.R
route_ihacres.Rd

Port of runoff_routing_gw(), taking a numeric vector rather than a data frame so it composes with any upstream runoff model.

Usage

route_ihacres(
  runoff,
  tau_q,
  tau_s,
  vs,
  loss = 0,
  slow_only = FALSE,
  max_loss = Inf,
  delay = 0,
  baseflow = 0,
  return_components = FALSE
)

Arguments

runoff

Numeric vector of runoff (no NA).

tau_q, tau_s

Quick and slow recession time constants (time steps).

vs

Fraction of runoff entering the slow store (0-1).

loss

Fraction lost to deep groundwater (0-1).

slow_only

If TRUE, losses come only from the slow store (capped at max_loss per step); otherwise from both.

max_loss

Maximum loss per time step when slow_only = TRUE.

delay

Whole-time-step lag applied to all components.

baseflow

Constant added to total flow (e.g. spring inflow).

return_components

If TRUE return a tibble of components.

Value

Numeric vector of routed flow, or a tibble with q_quick, q_slow, q_loss, q_total.
